paite: Hiai pen na kiang ua ka hong athumveina ding ahi. "Theihpih nih hiam, thum hiam kam ah thu chiteng hihkip in a-om ding hi."
heading: Paul Thuneihna

paite: Ka genkholta a, anihveina a na kiang ua ka om lai a ka gen bang in, tu'n ah na kiang ua om lou in, tuma lam a thil hihkhialte kiang ah leh midang tengteng kiang ah ka genkhol nawn dek hi, ka hong nawnleh ka hawi kei ding, chih;
Khrist keimah a thu gen zelpa pen chetna na zon ziak un, amah zaw noumau lam ah ahat lou kei a, na lak uah thilhihtheitak ahi zaw hi.
Hatlouhna a kilhlup himahleh Pathian thilhihtheihna ziak in ahing hi. Kou leng amah ah ka hat kei uhi, himahleh, noumau lam a Pathian thilhihtheihna ziak in akiang ah ka hing sam ding uhi.
Ginna ah na om na uhiam chih noumau ngeingei ki-enchian zel un. Ahihkeileh noumau ah Jesu Khrist a-om chih noumau ngeingei in na theichian kei ua hia? Deih louh na hih kei ngal uleh.
Koute deih louh in ka om kei uh chih na thei lai ding un ka gingta hi.

Huan thil himhim na hihkhelhlouhna ding un Pathian kiang ah ka ngen zel uhi; koute deihhuai a ka lattheihna ding uh ahi kei a, koute deih louh in om mah le ung noute'n akilawm peuhmah na hihtheihna ding uh ahi zaw hi.
Thutak gum ding lou in zaw, thutak dou ding in bangmah ka hihthei kei uhi.
Koute ka hat louh lai un noute na hat ua, ka kipak uhi; noumau hoih lam a na kibawlphat uh thumna a ka nget uh ahi.

Huaiziak in hihse ding hilou a bawlhoih ding zaw a, Toupa'n thuneihna ahon piak bang zel in, na kiang ua ka om chiang a nakpitak a ka hon taihilhlouhna ding in, na kiang ua ka om louh lai in hiai thu ka gelh ahi.

Atawp pen in, unaute aw, kipaktak in om un, na omdan uh kitungding unla; ka hon ngetna limsak un, kikhamuantuah in om unla; lungsim mun khat pu unla, kituaktak in om un; huan na kiang uah itna leh khamuanna Pathian a-om ding hi.
heading: Chibai Bukna

paite: Tawp siangthou in chibai kibuk un.
Misiangthou tengteng in chibai ahon buk uhi.
Toupa Jesu Khrist hehpihna, Pathian itna, Kha Siangthou kithuah-pihna na vek ua tung ah om hen, Amen.
